marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 乐龄乐活乐成长 ： 长者如何成功老龄化 | Le ling le huo le cheng zhang : zhang zhe ru he cheng gong lao ling hua

This book focuses on how the elderly age successfully, exploring how elderly believers can make use of their old age through income-generating secondary careers or volunteer services, maintaining physical and mental health, and living a life with a sense of value, fulfillment, and satisfaction. At the same time, it also inspires pastors and co-workers to face up to the aging of the church and actively promote the participation of elderly believers in secondary careers or volunteer services, so that they can become contributors, enjoy successful aging, and successfully complete their old age.
